scope: P3 trusted Atoll presence-accelerated Executor Attempt recovery
fault_cut: the first daemon is sent SIGKILL after its first baseline page is durable; the configured stale fallback is one hour
claims: Recruiting consumes Atoll substrate-owned member presence and uptime without adding a self-reported heartbeat or modifying core
only Attempts strictly older than the conservative Executor bind boundary are expired
presence loss releases the old Permit, retries the same Work, and accelerates its durable dispatch
a new daemon incarnation receives a distinct Attempt and restarts at page sequence 1
presence is advisory acceleration; Attempt, incarnation, acceptance and domain fences remain authoritative, with stale timeout as fallback

verification.environment: real Atoll Server, two real daemon processes, ordinary operator, Artifact File Resource, ephemeral MySQL 8.4 non-root accounts, public read-only website
ephemeral MySQL 8.4, separate non-root migrator/runtime accounts
